title: Captions
summary: Twelve caption styles in the glass look over the sample clip: frosted-glass pills (glass-pill is the default, glass-word for the fastest stretches), clean Inter Tight type, kinetic styles that mark emphasis on azure blocks.
usage: In a storyboard: {"captions": "glass-pill"}. glass-pill is the theme default; glass-word shows one word at a time; kinetic, kinetic-ink and kinetic-bold land each word a size too large with emphasis on azure blocks. Styles: library/themes/glass/captions/styles.js.
